app.name: CIQ Digital
app.description: Internal Beiersdorf backend for the Cosmetic Ingredient Questionnaire (CIQ): cases from creation to the final PDF with a parallel department review, open points, change requests, suppliers, versioned configuration, released sections, scope runs, RMES sheets, internal notes and a tamper-evident audit trail. Suppliers work only in the separate portal.

steps.name: Open items check – before release request
Waiting for supplier: final release PS-11

domain.summary: CIQ Digital (CIQ_Digital_A00) is the internal Beiersdorf backend for the Cosmetic Ingredient Questionnaire. RMM creates a case for a supplier raw material, receives basic data from the supplier (portal), runs the scope rules and releases sections, obtains the PS-05 completeness confirmation, then the active departments (Regulatory, Safety, QM, Microbiology, Sustainability, optionally RMM) review in parallel, raising open points with the supplier and (Safety, Regulatory) filling one RMES sheet each. Open-items checks and an optional overall approval precede the single PS-11 final release; the end produces a PDF. Supplier change requests are triaged by RMM and assessed in parallel. v4 model: 11 flows (3 Processes, 8 Data Forms) with child tables Contacts, Components, Criteria, Findings, Rounds; 11 custom roles plus Admin/User; the supplier acts only in the separate portal. PART A rules bind: no aggregates (Number count fields + blank-safe formulas), no pages, exact step names, intra-app automations Z1–Z4 only.

source.precedence: PART A (L19-L67) > PART B v4 (L71-L436) > PART C portal contract (L440-L609) > PART D v3 field reference (L613+)

scope.in: Backend: 11 flows (3 Processes, 8 Data Forms), child tables, ~20 lists, 11 custom roles + Admin/User, step permissions, grants, intra-app automations Z1–Z4
out: Native pages and nav (--no-pages); Workbench custom UI is later
Supplier portal flows (CIQP *) and portal role
Cross-container integrations X1–X6, Y1, Y3–Y6 (portal session)

personas.name: Raw Material Manager (RMM)
personas.description: Owns the CIQ case end to end and is the single intermediary between the Beiersdorf departments and the supplier. Creates the case, holds every 'Waiting for supplier' step and every check, runs scope check, triages change requests, maintains suppliers and contacts, and owns the optional RMM review branch (off by default).
goals: Create a case with all mandatory material, supplier, contact, owner and due-date data
Release the right scope (one section per Mandatory/Optional section, extend never reduce) and activate the right departments
Move the case through basic data, completeness PS-05, Part 2 review, optional overall approval and the single final release PS-11
Resolve leftovers at the two open-items checks, or override with an audited reason
Triage supplier change requests and refuse attempts after the final release
Cancel a case cleanly so no supplier task is left open; complete manually with a reason when needed
Keep supplier companies and their contacts (portal user ids) correct
pain_points: Kissflow has no field-change trigger, so supplier answer changes must arrive as change notices
Nobody may write the case during Part 2, so contact changes need their own open point
Native aggregates are unreliable, so gates depend on count fields written by the acting person
personas.evidence: brd.md L143; brd.md L157; brd.md L184-L193; brd.md L270; brd.md L278

goals: Review the Regulatory-led sections and sign off the REG lane (confirm, by, e-mail, time, on-behalf-of)
Ask the supplier specific, referenced questions and accept, withdraw or return each answer
Assess the impact of supplier change requests on earlier assessments
Fill the Regulatory RMES sheet (criteria, findings) and record the internal RMES decision with a reason
pain_points: Sign-off must be blocked while the department still has open points, unassessed change requests, RMES gaps or open findings

journeys.name: Create a CIQ case
journeys.trigger: RMM decides to qualify a supplier raw material (a new case cycle)
steps: Enter the material (trade name, main INCI, BDF, SAP and IRMA numbers) as plain case fields
Pick the supplier from CIQ Supplier and set the case contacts (contact list for display, portal contact ids, confirm contact ids, supplier contact e-mails)
Set owner and due dates
The pinned Release row (id, hash, manifest copy) is copied into the case
Submit; only after the submit succeeds the BASIC CIQ Section row is created (which creates the portal section)
journeys.outcome: A case at 'Waiting for supplier: basic data' with a pinned release and a BASIC section released to the portal
success_criteria: Missing mandatory data blocks creation
Contacts are fields on the case, never a child table
Exactly one BASIC section row per case
journeys.evidence: brd.md L184; brd.md L197-L199; brd.md L330; brd.md L335

journeys.name: Receive the supplier's basic data
journeys.trigger: The case enters 'Waiting for supplier: basic data'
steps: X1 creates the CIQP Request in the portal
The supplier submits basic data in the portal
Y1 sets 'basic data received' and the portal request id, and the step is approved
Fallback: RMM checks the portal and submits the step by hand
journeys.outcome: Case moves to Scope check
success_criteria: Supplier due date drives the step SLA and escalates to the owner
journeys.evidence: brd.md L185; brd.md L291; brd.md L296; brd.md L782

journeys.name: Scope check and section release
journeys.trigger: Basic data received (case at 'Scope check')
steps: Check BASIC answers (read through flow sharing); if incomplete, raise a query and wait
Run the scope rules into a CIQ Scope Run (every section incl. N.A., with rule and answer)
Optionally extend the scope with a justification (never reduce)
Release one CIQ Section row per Mandatory or Optional section (X2 creates each portal section)
Set which departments are active (Dept_<D>_Active) and the RMES key
journeys.outcome: Scope recorded, sections with the supplier, departments for Part 2 fixed; case moves to completeness PS-05
journeys.frequency: once per case (plus later runs for extensions, change notices, additional parts)
success_criteria: Additions only
N.A. sections get no section row but stay in the scope run with their rule
Scope-check SLA
journeys.evidence: brd.md L186; brd.md L280-L281; brd.md L783

journeys.name: Obtain the completeness confirmation (PS-05)
journeys.trigger: Case enters 'Waiting for supplier: completeness PS-05'
steps: X4 creates the CIQP Completeness Confirmation
The supplier confirms (name, e-mail, role, time)
Y4 records the confirmation and RMES_Created_At (RMES header) and approves
journeys.outcome: Questionnaire confirmed complete (data stays editable); exactly one RMES record header per case; Part 2 starts
success_criteria: Supplier due-date SLA
Completeness confirmation is not the final release
journeys.evidence: brd.md L187; brd.md L203; brd.md L294; brd.md L298; brd.md L560

journeys.name: Department review and sign-off in Part 2
journeys.trigger: The parallel block 'Part 2 – Beiersdorf review' starts; each active department's branch opens (RMM branch off by default)
steps: Review the sections the department leads
Raise open points to the supplier or internally as needed
Safety and Regulatory fill their RMES sheet (see j06)
Workbench writes the department's open-item counts at its own step
Sign off only the own lane fields: confirm, by, e-mail, time, on-behalf-of (SAF/REG also internal RMES decision and reason)
Delegation recorded via on-behalf-of and an audit event
journeys.outcome: Every active department's branch is done; native join moves the case on
journeys.frequency: once per active department per case
success_criteria: Submit blocked while the department has open points, unassessed change requests, RMES gaps or open findings
Inactive department branches are skipped
Review SLA with reminder and escalation (REQ-RMES-019)
journeys.evidence: brd.md L188-L189; brd.md L201; brd.md L208-L212; brd.md L825

journeys.name: Fill the RMES sheet (Safety / Regulatory)
journeys.trigger: First Safety (resp. Regulatory) session after PS-05
steps: Create the department's single RMES row for the case, keyed by the case's RMES_Key, with a reference to the case
Take the edit lock (Editing_By / Editing_Since)
Record each criterion: applicability, source, prefill, result, comment, limit check, impact resolution, AI suggestion and who confirmed it
Record findings (text, criterion, blocking, state, linked open point)
Lift header counts (open criteria, open blocking findings) for the case gate
Record the internal RMES decision on the case lane
journeys.outcome: A complete RMES sheet per department per case whose counts allow the lane sign-off
journeys.frequency: once per case per department (plus re-assessments)
success_criteria: Only one Safety (resp. Regulatory) user writes at a time
Regulatory can read Safety but not edit it, and vice versa
journeys.evidence: brd.md L282-L283; brd.md L331; brd.md L376; brd.md L433

journeys.name: Clarify with the supplier through an open point
journeys.trigger: A department (or RMM at Scope check) needs a query answered, a document, or an additional part
steps: Raise the point: kind, owner department, to-supplier yes, reference (section, field, row or document by file name and upload date), question, supplier-facing justification, responsible person, internal and supplier due dates
Additional part: RMM or the sync service creates its CIQ Section row
X3 creates the portal query for the current round
Supplier responds; Y3 copies the answer, sets Awaiting_Response = No and approves
The owning department reviews: Accepted (records the accepted document), Withdrawn (with reason), or Return (round appended to Rounds, next question written, item sent back to 'Waiting for supplier')
journeys.outcome: The point is closed (Accepted or Withdrawn) with its full round history in one item
journeys.frequency: many per case, mainly in Part 2
success_criteria: Every open point blocks its department's sign-off and the release request until closed
Only the owning department reviews the answer
Responsible person and due dates are required
journeys.evidence: brd.md L224-L229; brd.md L236-L246; brd.md L249-L251

journeys.name: Handle late and internal work through internal open points
journeys.trigger: A department is activated after the fork, a completed department's basis changed, contacts must change after PS-05, or a co-review is wanted
steps: Raise an internal open point (Department review / Contact update / Internal review); the supplier step is skipped
The owning department reviews and closes it
Its accepted outcome counts as the department's completion for that scope
journeys.outcome: Late work has a task with an owner, and the holds count it
success_criteria: No one writes the case during Part 2; contact changes go through a Contact update point
journeys.evidence: brd.md L231-L234; brd.md L210; brd.md L424; brd.md L426

journeys.name: Clear leftovers at the open-items checks
journeys.trigger: After the Part 2 join (before release request) or after the final release step (before close), something is still open or a count is blank
steps: Resolve late department reviews and contact updates
Copy late completions
Or override with a reason, which is audited
journeys.outcome: Nothing open blocks the release request or the close
success_criteria: A blank count holds; the gate never deadlocks
Normal path stays automatic
journeys.evidence: brd.md L190; brd.md L193; brd.md L32-L34

journeys.name: Overall approval
journeys.trigger: Case reaches 'Overall approval' and Overall_Approval_Required = Yes
steps: Check every required RMES decision
Approve, or reject with a neutral closing text
journeys.outcome: Approved: the release request goes out. Rejected: the case ends without a release request and the close sweep runs
journeys.frequency: per case when switched on (off by default)
success_criteria: Approve only if every required RMES decision is Approved
Comes before the PS-11 release request
journeys.evidence: brd.md L191; brd.md L63; brd.md L220

journeys.name: Final release (PS-11) and close
journeys.trigger: Case enters 'Waiting for supplier: final release PS-11' (not overall-rejected)
steps: X5 sends the single release request
Supplier releases; Y5 records the release (released revisions, evidence list) and approves
Or RMM completes manually with a reason
Open items check before close if something opened during this step
End: Z1 produces the PDF, e-mails the RMM owner and the supplier contacts, logs the notification
journeys.outcome: Case completed with a final PDF; nothing editable by the supplier afterwards
success_criteria: Exactly one release request per case (REQ-PROC-040)
Manual completion carries a reason (REQ-PROC-045)
journeys.evidence: brd.md L192-L194; brd.md L301; brd.md L62

journeys.name: Cancel a case
journeys.trigger: The case must stop before completion
steps: RMM rejects at its own steps; in Part 2 the Case Admin rejects through the admin route
A Cancellation audit event is written
The case's open open points and change requests are ended
The close sweep snapshots and withdraws every open portal item
Z2 sends a neutral e-mail to the supplier
journeys.outcome: Case cancelled with no supplier task left open (REQ-PROC-049)
success_criteria: Same sweep after an overall rejection or a manual completion
journeys.evidence: brd.md L214-L220; brd.md L38; brd.md L413

journeys.name: Handle a supplier change request
journeys.trigger: Supplier submits a change request or change notice in the portal (Y6 creates the app item; RMM by hand as fallback)
steps: Triage: check the requester is a contact of the case
After PS-11: refuse and write a 'change attempt' audit event
Change notice: new scope run (additions only); new sections become section rows; a Department-review point for each new section's lead department
Set impact flags per department and the supplier-safe outcome text
Affected departments assess in parallel ('Assess – <dept>'), each writing only its own four fields; re-assessment goes into the RMES sheet
End: X6 sends the CIQP Notice with the outcome
journeys.outcome: Scope re-derived, affected departments informed and assessed, supplier notified
journeys.frequency: whenever a supplier changes configuration/metadata answers or asks for a correction
success_criteria: Every configuration answer change re-derives the scope (REQ-CFG-008, REQ-PROC-007)
Attempts after release refused and logged (REQ-PROC-043)
Affected departments informed (REQ-PROC-031)
journeys.evidence: brd.md L255-L272; brd.md L295; brd.md L299

journeys.name: Maintain suppliers and their contacts
journeys.trigger: A new supplier or contact is needed for a case, or contact data changes
steps: Create or update the supplier (code, legal name, DUNS, kind, country, SAP and Teamcenter ids, active, test)
Add contacts as rows: name, e-mail, role, may confirm, portal user id, active, invite requested/invited
Write rows one at a time, re-read and merge
Keep the parent mirrors (contact portal ids for search, pending invites count)
journeys.outcome: Every contact on a case has a portal user id; suppliers are searchable
success_criteria: One portal user serving two suppliers gets a row under each
Supplier_Code is the isolation key on every portal item
journeys.evidence: brd.md L278; brd.md L329

journeys.name: Author and publish configuration
journeys.trigger: Business wants to change templates, section definitions, rules, ownership, RMES criteria, limits, texts, reminders or settings
steps: Write a new config version row per kind (copy-on-write; never edit a published row)
Publish a Release row with the full bundle and its hash
Each publish writes an audit event
Download any version
journeys.outcome: New cases pin the new release; pinned releases never change
success_criteria: No four-eyes (A3)
No delete for the writer (K-17)
journeys.evidence: brd.md L279; brd.md L65; brd.md L375

journeys.name: Discuss a case internally
journeys.trigger: Any internal user wants to comment on a case, section, open point or finding
steps: Post one message (case, optional link, text, author, department, time)
Author edits only their own messages, by convention
journeys.outcome: Internal discussion attached to the case, never visible to suppliers (REQ-PROC-020)
success_criteria: Never shared with the portal
journeys.evidence: brd.md L284; brd.md L316

journeys.name: Inspect who did what and when
journeys.trigger: Audit, legal, customs or process-owner inquiry
steps: Read the audit events of a case or of configuration: who, what, when, old and new value, document by file name and upload date
Includes notifications, delegations, assignments, section-review marks, scope, configuration, change attempts, cancellations, snapshots, item created
journeys.outcome: A tamper-evident trail answers the inquiry (REQ-CTL-009, REQ-CTL-010)
success_criteria: Beiersdorf roles cannot delete audit rows
journeys.evidence: brd.md L285; brd.md L66; brd.md L431

journeys.name: Find cases by ingredient, origin or supplier
journeys.trigger: A user needs every case containing an INCI/CAS, an origin type or a supplier (DUNS)
steps: Search the K2.1 and BASIC section rows' search mirrors and the K2.1 Components rows
Components are rebuilt from portal answers whenever they change and once after the final release
journeys.outcome: Cases found without opening documents (REQ-PROC-006)
success_criteria: Search mirrors are on a Form row, writable at any time
journeys.evidence: brd.md L280; brd.md L332; brd.md L429

journeys.name: Keep app and portal consistent (sync service)
journeys.trigger: Case cancelled, overall-rejected, manually completed, completed, or portal answers changed; X2/X3 fallback needed
steps: Close sweep: snapshot and withdraw every open portal item
Render the final PDF (option A)
Rebuild K2.1 Components
Create portal items as fallback for X2/X3
Write audit events
journeys.outcome: No orphan supplier task; PDF and components up to date
success_criteria: Never acts on a human step after Start
journeys.evidence: brd.md L218; brd.md L318-L320; brd.md L357-L364; brd.md L406

journeys.name: Reactivate a case (new cycle)
journeys.trigger: A cancelled case must be resumed within the period set in Settings
steps: Create a new case item with the same case code and cycle + 1
A reactivation scope run is recorded
New sections carry the previous answers as prefill from section snapshots

business_rules.statement: A Process is used only when the record moves through steps that carry SLAs (built-in SLA notifications); otherwise a Data Form. No process without steps.

No extra records: repeated detail lives in a child table inside its parent (or fields on the parent) when one writer, no integration on rows, few bounded rows and no cross-case search all hold; otherwise its own record.
business_rules.evidence: brd.md L24; brd.md L96; brd.md L105-L111

business_rules.statement: Exactly 11 flows: 3 Processes (CIQ Case, CIQ Open Point, CIQ Change Request) and 8 Data Forms; dropped entities (Raw Material, Case Contact, Supplier Contact, Component, Config Release, per-round items, per-criterion RMES rows) are not reintroduced.
business_rules.evidence: brd.md L13; brd.md L115; brd.md L131-L138

business_rules.statement: Use parallel steps where Kissflow supports them: Part 2 review on the case and Assess impact on the change request.
business_rules.evidence: brd.md L25; brd.md L188; brd.md L271

business_rules.statement: Child-table step permissions name the child table only, never its columns.
A child-table column never reuses a header field id; it gets a prefixed id (e.g. Rounds_Round_No).
No native aggregates are authored. Gates and holds use plain Number count fields written by the acting person's Workbench at their own step, read by server-side formulas.
Gate and hold formulas are blank-safe: a blank count holds and never deadlocks.
List ids are authored without the _A00 suffix.

Only intra-app automations are modelled: Z1 (case completed → PDF, e-mails, notification event), Z2 (case rejected/cancellation → neutral e-mail), Z3/Z4 (SLA breach on CIQ Case / CIQ Open Point → audit event). They come out incomplete and are finished over REST.
Cross-container integrations X1–X6 and Y1/Y3–Y6 are documentation only (the portal session builds them); no automation points at a portal flow.
No field is named Name, Status, Type, Country, Priority, Category, Currency or Project; generic words are owner-prefixed.
Every flow and list name starts with 'CIQ '.

Step names are exact (en-dash U+2013 where shown): 'Waiting for supplier: basic data', 'Waiting for supplier: completeness PS-05', 'Waiting for supplier: final release PS-11', 'Part 2 – Beiersdorf review', 'Review – Regulatory/Safety/QM/Microbiology/Sustainability/RMM', 'Open items check – before release request', 'Overall approval', 'Open items check – before close'; Open Point 'Waiting for supplier'; Change Request 'Triage' then parallel 'Assess impact' with 'Assess – Regulatory' … 'Assess – Sustainability'. The portal triggers on these names.
Editable on a Process also grants item creation, and flow Admin cannot be expressed; both are fixed over REST after generate.
No pages are added (backend only, --no-pages): a page auto-grant turns readers into editors.
The account key cannot act after Start; every human step is done by a person (Workbench or native), never by the sync service.
CIQ Sync Service is in scope: close sweep, snapshots, X2/X3 fallback, single-writer audit, component rebuild, PDF renderer (option A).
Overall approval, when switched on, comes before the PS-11 release request.
Safety and Regulatory reviewers record their internal RMES decision themselves; no separate approver roles.
No four-eyes on configuration releases.
The audit trail is claimed as 'tamper-evident'.
Roles are exactly the 11 custom roles plus the defaults Admin and User.
Never model, reference or write portal (CIQP) flows or the 'CIQ ZZ Spike' test flows in this app.

Case creation requires material, supplier, case contacts (Portal_Contact_Ids, Confirm_Contact_Ids, Supplier_Contact_Emails mandatory at Start), owner and due dates; the pinned Release row is copied in.
The BASIC section row is created only after the case submit succeeds.
CIQ RMM creates the case and holds every 'Waiting for supplier' step and both checks; after the K-FA test the basic-data step is assigned from Owner_RMM.

Every case step carries an SLA whose duration Beiersdorf sets; supplier waiting steps use the supplier due date and escalate to the owner; review steps have a reminder and an escalation (REQ-RMES-019).
Scope can be extended with a justification but never reduced; every scope run records additions only.
One CIQ Section row per Mandatory or Optional section; N.A. sections get no row but stay in the scope run with their rule and answer.
business_rules.evidence: brd.md L186; brd.md L125; brd.md L986

business_rules.statement: A Part 2 branch runs only when Dept_<D>_Active = 'Yes'; the RMM branch is off by default; the case moves on only when every active branch is done (native join).
A department's Part 2 sign-off is blocked while it has open points, unassessed change requests, RMES gaps or open findings — by the Workbench and by a native gate field on count fields.
Each Part 2 branch writes only its own 5–7 lane fields and no child tables; nobody else writes the case during Part 2 (contact changes via a Contact-update point, assignments via audit events).
'Open items check – before release request' and '– before close' run only if something is open (a blank count also holds); an override needs a reason and is audited.

Overall approval runs only if Overall_Approval_Required = 'Yes' (off by default); approve only if every required RMES decision is Approved; on rejection the case ends without a release request and a neutral closing text goes to the supplier.
'Waiting for supplier: final release PS-11' is skipped if overall-rejected; X5 sends the single release request (REQ-PROC-040); RMM can complete manually with a reason (REQ-PROC-045).

Cancellation: RMM rejects at its own steps; in Part 2 the Case Admin rejects via the admin route; an audit Cancellation event is written; the case's open P2/P3 items are ended; the close sweep snapshots and withdraws every open portal item (REQ-PROC-049). The same sweep runs after an overall rejection or a manual completion.
End of the case triggers Z1: PDF, e-mails to the RMM owner and the supplier contacts, notification log.

Case identity and material fields are plain scalars (Trade_Name, Main_INCI, BDF_Material_No as Text that X1 reads); case contacts are fields, never a child table, because integrations can read only fields.
RMES_Key plus RMES_Created_At from Y4 are the case's single RMES record header (REQ-PROC-021).
After generate: Case Send-back off on every step and Reject only on RMM steps; Open Point Send-back only at review steps; Change Request Send-back and Reject off.
Raising an open point requires kind, owner department, to-supplier yes/no, reference, question, supplier-facing justification, responsible person, internal and supplier due dates (REQ-ADR-001).
Every open point blocks its department's sign-off and the release request until closed (REQ-PROC-036).
'Waiting for supplier' runs only when OP_To_Supplier = 'Yes'; internal kinds (Department review, Contact update, Internal review) skip it.
Exactly one review step runs, chosen by OP_Dept; only the owning department reviews the answer (REQ-PROC-034).

Review outcomes: Accepted (records the accepted document), Withdrawn (with reason), or Return (round appended to Rounds, next question/justification/due date written, answer cleared, Awaiting_Response = 'Yes', item sent back to 'Waiting for supplier').
Y3 approves 'Waiting for supplier' only while Awaiting_Response = 'Yes'.
Only the owning department writes the Rounds child table, at its own step.
App_Open_Point_Id means the point, not the round; each round still gets its own CIQP Query with its round number.
An additional part asks RMM (or the sync service) to create its CIQ Section row.
Change requests are created by Y6 from the portal (RMM by hand as fallback) and triaged by CIQ RMM, who checks the requester is a contact of the case.
A change attempt after PS-11 is refused and logged as an audit 'change attempt' event (REQ-PROC-043).
A change notice writes a new scope run (additions only); new sections become section rows and a Department-review point is raised for each new section's lead department.
Each Assess branch runs only if Impact_<D> = 'Yes' and writes only its own four fields; re-assessment goes into that department's RMES sheet; the change request end sends X6 (CIQP Notice).
CIQ Supplier is written by CIQ RMM; Business Admin is Viewer unless BDF says otherwise; contact rows are written one at a time, re-read and merged.
A portal user serving two suppliers gets a contact row under each supplier.

CIQ Config Version is written by CIQ Business Admin as member without Delete (K-17); copy-on-write: publishing never edits a row; each publish writes an audit event; versions are downloadable (REQ-CFG-001/-003).
A Release row holds the full bundle plus hash so a pinned release never depends on rows that could change.
CIQ Section is written only by CIQ RMM and CIQ Integration Service; reviewers are Viewers.
K2.1 Components are rebuilt from the portal answers (read via sharing) whenever they change and once after the final release.
CIQ Scope Run rows are written by the session that ran the rules: RMM, or a department for an extension.
CIQ RMES Safety is written by Safety only; Regulatory can read but not edit it, and vice versa for CIQ RMES Regulatory (REQ-CFG-004).
One RMES row per case and department, created by the first session after PS-05 and keyed by RMES_Key; the Editing_By/Editing_Since lock allows only one writer at a time.
Every internal role writes CIQ Internal Note; the author edits only their own messages by convention; never visible to suppliers (REQ-PROC-020).
CIQ Audit Event: recommended single writer CIQ Integration Service with every person Viewer; otherwise writers without Delete and the claim is 'tamper-evident' (REQ-CTL-009, REQ-CTL-010).
Never shared with the portal: department lanes and decisions, RMES, findings, internal notes, internal due dates, the overall decision, the audit trail.
Section answers and uploads are read from the portal through flow sharing, not copied.
